text:
tess: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A about hybrid/workation/offsite logistics. Dropping short answers here and will make a one-pager.

ryan: Two quick ones: 1) Can I tack on personal travel to a company trip and get any part reimbursed? 2) Are day-care reimbursements available for mandatory offsites?

julie: For personal detours, company reimburses only the business portion. Attach manager approval + cost comparison. Childcare: case-by-case for mandatory events, manager pre-approval required; receipts must be submitted.

people-ops-bot: Offsite & Workation FAQ uploaded -> https://intranet.redwood/policies/offsite_workation_faq (edited)

ryan: Hoteling conflicts at HQ are still popping up. Any interim rule?

ops: Interim priority: meeting organizer > recurring desk owner > first-come hoteling. If conflict, post a screenshot in #desk-ops and we’ll reconcile. New hoteling UI ships next week.

tess: What about coworking day passes vs stipend?

julie: Opt-in coworking stipend $150/month. For ad-hoc trips, day-pass receipts <= $30/day reimbursable under Travel-Other. If frequent, opt into stipend.

ceo: Leadership note: for visits to Dedicated/private infra, request security clearance 72 hours ahead. No same-day exceptions.

tess: I’ll publish a one-page flow (workation request, guest rules, reimbursements) by Friday. Volunteers to review?

ryan: I can review the expense snippets.

julie: I’ll check the childcare/accommodation language.

people-ops-bot: Draft one-pager added to all-hands follow-ups: https://intranet.redwood/allhands/sep-2026/offsite-quick-guide (edited)

tess: Closing thread for edits at 1794569600. DM for edge cases.
